aria.value: Help text, counter, and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the textarea.

focus: The textarea shows the focus indicator (focus-ring-width outline in color-focus-ring, border color, and a 1px ring).
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by the native required attribute.
Errors appear after the first blur by default so users are not interrupted while typing.
The character count is announced through a polite live region only near or over the limit, 750 ms after typing stops.
Auto-grow keeps the whole value visible up to maxRows, which helps users review what they wrote.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of the counter has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
